name: Screen Narrator
description: Reads any window, PDF or Kindle page aloud, and can translate it first. Text recognition and voices run on your computer (Tesseract, Kokoro, Piper); translation uses your own llama.cpp, LM Studio or Ollama server or the offline NLLB model. Click the headphones in the top bar for Start, Pause and Stop; right-click starts or stops reading.
